newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Jinro Group shares limit up on aid hopes.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Jinro Group shares limit up on aid hopes.

text.p: Shares of three Jinro Group affiliates went limit up on Monday on market talk that creditors had decided to extend emergency loans for the financially troubled group, brokers said.
Jinro Ltd, flagship of the Jinro Group, added 580 won to 7,890. Both Jinro Industries and Jinro General Foods rose 330 won and 320 won to 4,540 and 4,320 respectively.
According to the market talk, a voluntary committee by financial institutions has decided to grant 100 billion won in emergency loans to bail out six major Jinro companies.
But committee representatives denied the speculation and said the panel was still conferring.
The committee was set up to prevent major corporate failures following the earlier failures of Hanbo and Sammi.
